title.en: A limited Nana Osaki reading

paragraphs.en: Nana Osaki is a vocalist pursuing music with Black Stones in the story. This edition takes a limited angle from that creative setting: wanting a shared piece to retain a recognisable idea. Your choices do not establish artistic talent, independence, charisma or a life history like hers. A fictional connection is a prompt for comparison, not an assessment of your identity.
paragraphs.zh: 作品中的大崎娜娜是追求音乐的Black Stones主唱。本版从这个创作背景取一个有限角度：希望共同作品仍保留认得出的想法。本次选择不确立艺术天分、独立、魅力或与她相似的人生经历。人物联想用来比较，不是身份评估。

title.en: The small zine that still feels like yours
title.zh: 小刊仍然像自己的作品

paragraphs.en: Imagine making a short zine with friends. The practical plan needs to shrink, but you want to preserve the central idea that first made everyone interested. You explain that idea and invite suggestions for expressing it with fewer pages. Keeping a voice can coexist with compromise; it does not require controlling everyone’s contribution or refusing every change.
paragraphs.zh: 比如和朋友做小刊，实际计划需要缩减，但你想留下最初吸引大家的核心想法。可以说清它，再邀请用更少页数表达的办法。守住声音能与妥协共存，不必控制所有人的贡献，也不必拒绝每个改动。

title.en: Six other contributions to the same piece
title.zh: 同一作品里的另外六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Hachi gives ordinary shared time warmth; Ren refines a detail. Takumi considers resources, Nobu expresses appreciation plainly, Shin tries an adjustable role and Yasu clarifies shared responsibility. Nana Osaki’s angle keeps the expressive idea visible. These contributions need not compete, and another guide can be useful without becoming a hidden second personality or a claim about your relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 阿八给普通相处添心意，莲打磨细节；巧考虑资源，伸夫真诚说出欣赏，真一试可调整的角色，泰士说清共同责任。大崎娜娜角度让表达想法保持可见。这些贡献不必竞争，另一说明也能有用，不会变成隐藏第二人格或关系判断。

title.en: When a clear voice needs a clearer invitation
title.zh: 表达鲜明，也要邀请清楚

paragraphs.en: An important idea can be difficult for others to join if its owner never explains what can change. You might separate the part you care about from the parts you are happy to adapt. That gives collaborators real room to contribute. This is a possible project question, not evidence that a high count means stubbornness, possessiveness or fear of being left behind.
paragraphs.zh: 重要想法如果没说明哪些能改，别人可能难以加入。可以区分自己在意的部分和愿意调整的部分，给伙伴实际贡献空间。这只是项目里可以提的问题，不证明高计数意味着固执、占有欲或害怕被丢下。

title.en: Try one sentence about the idea

paragraphs.en: For one small creative task, write a sentence naming what you hope the piece will express. Ask a collaborator what they hear in that sentence and which form they would enjoy trying. Compare the result with your intention afterwards. The experiment is about communication around a project, not proving that you have a distinctive personality or must pursue a music career.
paragraphs.zh: 挑一次小创作，用一句话写希望作品表达什么。问伙伴听出了什么、想用哪种形式试，做完再比较成果和初衷。这是在试项目沟通，不是在证明自己人格独特，也不要求走音乐职业。

title.en: A limited Hachi reading

paragraphs.en: Nana Komatsu, called Hachi, is one of the two leads whose life becomes intertwined with Nana Osaki’s in Tokyo. This edition focuses on small gestures that make shared time feel connected. Your choices do not diagnose attachment, dependency, maturity or romantic needs. They describe which offered everyday contributions appealed now, without reproducing the character’s private or dramatic story.
paragraphs.zh: 小松奈奈被叫作阿八，是在东京与大崎娜娜人生交织的两位主角之一。本版聚焦让共同时间更有联结感的小心意。本次选择不诊断依恋、依赖、成熟度或恋爱需要，只描述现在较喜欢哪些日常贡献，不复制人物私密或戏剧性的经历。

title.en: An evening with no special occasion
title.zh: 没有特别理由的一个晚上

paragraphs.en: Two friends share a hobby space and have an ordinary evening free. A small familiar drink, a short conversation or a remembered preference can make being there feel shared rather than merely simultaneous. The gesture need not be elaborate. It matters whether the other person welcomes it, and whether you have enough room for your own way of spending the evening too.
paragraphs.zh: 两位朋友共用兴趣空间，晚上没有特别安排。一杯熟悉饮品、一段简短交流、一个被记住的偏好，就可能让同处变成相处，不必隆重。也要看对方是否欢迎，以及自己是否仍有空间按想要的方式过这一晚。

title.en: Connection beside six other angles

paragraphs.en: Nana Osaki keeps a creative idea visible; Ren refines a detail and Takumi fits the plan to resources. Nobu says what he appreciates, Shin explores a flexible role and Yasu clarifies agreements. Hachi’s angle notices the texture of everyday time together. Practical work and creative ambition can carry that same care, so no result divides people into caring and uncaring camps.
paragraphs.zh: 大崎娜娜守住创意，莲打磨细节，巧让计划和资源相配；伸夫说出欣赏，真一探索灵活角色，泰士约清责任。阿八角度注意平常相处的质感。实际工作和创作追求同样能带着心意，结果不会把人分成有情与无情阵营。

title.en: An invitation is not a hidden obligation

paragraphs.en: A shared ritual may feel warm on one day and unnecessary on another. Someone can decline without making the relationship less meaningful. If an offer starts to feel compulsory, ask which part is actually welcome and state what you want too. The count cannot tell whether you need reassurance, should change a relationship or resemble Hachi’s romantic decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 共同小习惯今天温暖，另一天也可能不需要。别人谢绝，不会因此让关系失去意义。邀请变得像必须参加时，可问哪些真正受欢迎，也说自己的想法。计数看不出是否需要安慰、该不该改变关系，或会不会重复阿八的恋爱决定。

title.en: Try a small, answerable invitation
title.zh: 试一次容易回答的小邀请

paragraphs.en: Offer one small shared moment with a clear option to join, adapt or skip it. You might ask whether a person wants a short break together rather than preparing a whole evening for them. Afterwards notice what both of you enjoyed. No fictional match requires you to take care of everyone, disclose private experiences or make closeness the goal of every activity.
paragraphs.zh: 邀请一小段共同时间，让对方容易回答参加、调整或跳过。可以问要不要一起短暂休息，不必替别人准备整晚。之后留意双方喜欢什么。虚构匹配不要求照顾所有人、透露私事，也不把每项活动都变成拉近关系的任务。

title.en: A limited Ren reading

paragraphs.en: Ren Honjo is a guitarist and composer associated with Trapnest, after earlier playing with Black Stones. This edition uses only a modest creative angle: enjoying sustained attention to a piece of work. Selecting these responses does not measure musical skill, dedication, emotional distance or any clinical condition. It gives no reason to adopt or excuse the character’s harmful experiences or actions.
paragraphs.zh: 本城莲是与Trapnest相关的吉他手和作曲者，之前也参与Black Stones。本版只借一个朴素创作角度：喜欢持续关注一件作品。选择这些回应不测音乐技能、投入程度、情感疏离或临床状况，也不要求模仿或为人物的伤害性经历、行为免责。

title.en: One passage rather than the whole project

paragraphs.en: A short hobby session gives you time to work on one passage, transition or visual detail. You stay with that part because the process itself is enjoyable, then decide when to leave it for another day. The meaningful distinction is the chosen focus, rather than whether the finished work is impressive or someone else would call the time productive.
paragraphs.zh: 短短兴趣时间，可以只打磨一个段落、过渡或视觉细节。因为过程本身有趣而专注，再决定何时放到改天继续。区别在主动选择的关注点，不在成品惊不惊艳，也不在别人会不会把这段时间叫作高效。

title.en: Craft beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Nana Osaki protects an expressive idea; Hachi makes shared time feel connected. Takumi organises resources, Nobu communicates appreciation, Shin adjusts a new role and Yasu clarifies responsibilities. Ren’s angle stays with a concrete creative detail. Careful work can help any of the other contributions, and another person’s broader or more social focus does not make their interest shallower.
paragraphs.zh: 大崎娜娜守住表达，阿八让相处有联结；巧安排资源，伸夫说出欣赏，真一调整新角色，泰士约清责任。莲的角度持续关注具体创作细节。细细做事可以支持其他贡献，别人看得更广或更重共同交流，也不表示兴趣较浅。

title.en: Focus can need a shared boundary

paragraphs.en: A detail can absorb more time than the group expected. If others are waiting for a handover, explain what you are doing and agree when the current version is usable. The question is how your focus fits the shared task. A raw count cannot establish perfectionism, avoidance, superior ability or a need to work alone.
paragraphs.zh: 细节可能花掉比小组预计更多的时间。别人等交接时，可以说清自己在做什么，约好当前版本何时可以用。问题是这份专注怎样融入共同任务。原始计数不能确立完美主义、逃避、更高能力或必须独自工作的需要。

title.en: Choose a detail and a stopping point
title.zh: 选一处细节，也选一个收尾点

paragraphs.en: For one optional project, select a detail you genuinely want to explore and a point at which you will share the current version. Afterwards ask what changed and whether the process was enjoyable. You can keep practising, change direction or stop. None of those choices confirms or removes a fixed character identity, and the quiz cannot certify talent.
paragraphs.zh: 挑一个自愿小项目，选真正想探索的细节，也选一个分享当前版本的收尾点。结束后问发生了什么变化、过程是否有趣。继续练、换方向或停下都可以；这些都不确认或撤销固定角色身份，测试也不能认证天分。

title.en: Takumi Ichinose

title.en: A limited Takumi reading

paragraphs.en: Takumi Ichinose is Trapnest’s leader and bassist in the story. This edition isolates a practical project angle: coordinating an agreed aim with time, space and materials. Selecting these options does not endorse the character’s behaviour or establish that you are controlling, manipulative or suited to leadership. Resources are discussed through consent and shared decisions, without turning a fictional role into a judgement of a real person.
paragraphs.zh: 一之濑巧在作品中是Trapnest的领队与贝斯手。本版只取实际项目角度：让约好的目标和时间、空间、材料相配。选择这些回应不认可人物行为，也不认定你控制、操控别人或适合领导。资源安排依靠同意与共同决定，不把虚构角色变成真人判断。

title.en: A showcase that can actually happen
title.zh: 一场确实办得起来的展示

paragraphs.en: Your hobby group has one room, a short evening and more ideas than it can fit. You propose a manageable aim, list what is available and ask everyone which parts they can support. That makes the arrangement discussable. It does not give one person authority over another’s time or mean that completing the event matters more than the people involved.
paragraphs.zh: 兴趣小组只有一间房、一个短晚上，点子却很多。可以提出能办到的目标，列清现有条件，再问大家愿意支持哪些部分，让安排有得商量。这不赋予任何人支配别人时间的权力，也不表示办成活动比参与的人更重要。

title.en: Resources beside six other angles

paragraphs.en: Nana Osaki keeps the creative idea visible; Hachi attends to shared everyday time and Ren refines a detail. Nobu expresses appreciation plainly, Shin tests an adjustable role and Yasu clarifies responsibilities. Takumi’s limited angle concerns how the plan fits its resources. All seven can cooperate, and a preference for planning cannot be converted into moral character or relationship behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 大崎娜娜守住创意，阿八照顾日常相处，莲打磨细节；伸夫真诚表达欣赏，真一试可调整角色，泰士约清责任。巧的有限角度关注计划与资源怎样匹配。七者可以合作，喜欢规划不能换算成道德品格或关系行为。

title.en: Leave the agreement revisable

paragraphs.en: A workable plan can still fail to reflect what people want. If someone’s time or interest changes, revisit the aim rather than treating the first agreement as permanent. Ask which part can shrink or move. The count cannot tell whether you manage resources effectively, can make decisions for others or share the darker aspects of a fictional character.
paragraphs.zh: 计划可操作，也可能不再符合大家想要的事。有人时间或兴趣变了，就重看目标，不把最初约定当永久承诺；可以问哪部分缩减或挪动。计数看不出资源管理是否有效，更不授权替别人决定，或认定你具有虚构人物的阴暗面。

title.en: Try a small plan people can edit
title.zh: 试一份大家能改的小计划

paragraphs.en: For one optional shared task, write down the aim, available resources and proposed contribution from each person. Invite edits and a clear option not to participate. Afterward review whether the plan served its agreed purpose. This is a trial of coordination, not proof of professional management ability, permission to control others or justification for harm in the story.
paragraphs.zh: 挑一项自愿共同任务，写清目标、现有资源、建议各人贡献，邀请修改，也留出不参加的选择。结束后看计划是否服务了共同目的。这是在试协调方式，不证明职业管理能力、不授权控制别人，也不为剧情伤害提供理由。

title.en: A limited Nobu reading

paragraphs.en: Nobuo Terashima, called Nobu, is a Black Stones guitarist and an old friend of Nana Osaki. This edition uses a narrow interpersonal creative angle: saying what you appreciate and what you mean plainly. Your choices do not measure kindness, honesty, romantic compatibility or moral integrity. They describe one possible contribution to a shared activity, without assigning the character’s personal relationships to you.
paragraphs.zh: 寺岛伸夫被叫作Nobu，是Black Stones吉他手，也是大崎娜娜的旧友。本版只取共同创作中的一个交往角度：把欣赏和本意真诚说清。本次选择不测善良、诚实、恋爱适配或道德完整性，只描述共同活动里的一种贡献，不把人物关系赋给你。

title.en: An early sketch with a clear response
title.zh: 草图收到一句清楚回应

paragraphs.en: A friend sends a sketch before it is finished. You identify a specific line or idea you enjoyed and explain what you actually understood from it. That can make feedback more usable than a vague compliment. You can also ask whether they want a suggestion; appreciation need not arrive bundled with advice or a promise you cannot keep.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友把未完成草图发来，可以指出具体喜欢的一笔或一个想法，说清实际读懂了什么，比笼统夸奖更好用。也可以问是否需要建议；欣赏不必捆着意见，更不必附上一份自己做不到的承诺。

title.en: Expression beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Nana Osaki names a creative intention; Hachi makes ordinary shared time feel connected and Ren works on a detail. Takumi considers resources, Shin explores an adjustable role and Yasu makes agreements clear. Nobu’s angle puts appreciation and intentions into direct words. Those words can support any other contribution, without making one person more sincere than someone who chooses a different option.
paragraphs.zh: 大崎娜娜说出创作意图，阿八让日常相处有联结，莲打磨细节；巧考虑资源，真一探索灵活角色，泰士说清约定。伸夫角度把欣赏和本意直接表达出来。这能支持其他贡献，但不表示这样选的人比用其他方式的人更真诚。

title.en: Warm words still need a clear purpose
title.zh: 温暖话语也要目的清楚

paragraphs.en: A supportive comment can become confusing if the listener hears a commitment you did not intend. If that happens, clarify what you can offer rather than adding more reassurance. This is a possible communication adjustment, not a conclusion that a high Nobu count means indecision, self-doubt or a particular romantic pattern. A quiz cannot resolve another person’s expectations for you.
paragraphs.zh: 支持的话如果让对方听成自己原本没打算的承诺，也会混乱。这时可说清实际能提供什么，不必继续加安慰。这只是沟通调整，不说明高伸夫计数意味着犹豫、自我怀疑或某种恋爱模式。测试也不能代替双方处理期待。

title.en: Try one specific appreciation

paragraphs.en: Choose one low-stakes piece someone is willing to share. Describe a detail you appreciate, explain what you understood and ask whether that response fits what they wanted. Notice how the conversation develops without trying to make the person agree with you. There is no need to be everyone’s reassuring friend or treat a fictional match as a requirement to remain agreeable.
paragraphs.zh: 选一件别人愿意分享的小作品，说一处具体欣赏、说明读懂了什么，再问这种回应是否符合对方需要。看看交流怎样发展，不要求对方同意自己。不必成为所有人的安慰者，也不把虚构匹配变成始终随和的义务。

title.en: A limited Shin reading

paragraphs.en: Shinichi Okazaki, called Shin, joins Black Stones as a bassist. This edition uses a limited newcomer angle: trying an unfamiliar role while retaining room to adjust it. Your choices do not imply his age, personal history, maturity or experiences in the story. Adaptability here is an offered response in an ordinary activity, not a validated ability or a requirement to fit into every group.
paragraphs.zh: 冈崎真一被叫作Shin，作为贝斯手加入Black Stones。本版只取新参与者的有限角度：试陌生角色，同时留出调整空间。本次选择不暗示人物年龄、个人经历、成熟度或剧情遭遇。这里的灵活只是普通活动里的一个回应，不是已验证能力，也不要求适应每个小组。

title.en: A first role that can change
title.zh: 第一次分工也可以调整

paragraphs.en: A creative group offers you a task you have not done before. You agree to try a small version, ask what support is available and keep the option to revise your involvement after learning more. That lets the role become a genuine choice. It need not mean hiding your uncertainty or accepting whatever the group would prefer you to do.
paragraphs.zh: 创作小组给了自己没做过的任务，可以先试一个小版本，问清有哪些支持，也保留了解后调整参与的选择。这样分工才真是选择，不必藏起不确定，也不必别人希望做什么就全部接下。

title.en: Flexibility beside six other angles

paragraphs.en: Nana Osaki keeps an expressive idea visible; Hachi adds an everyday connection and Ren refines a detail. Takumi fits the aim to resources, Nobu speaks appreciatively and Yasu clarifies agreements. Shin’s angle experiments with how a person can take part. An adjustable role can support all six contributions, without making someone less committed or more independent than a person who prefers a settled role.
paragraphs.zh: 大崎娜娜保留表达，阿八加入日常联结，莲打磨细节；巧让目标和资源相配，伸夫表达欣赏，泰士说清约定。真一角度探索怎样参与。可调整角色能支持其余六种贡献，不让人较不投入，也不证明比偏好固定分工的人更独立。

title.en: Make a change visible to others

paragraphs.en: Flexibility can become difficult for collaborators if a changed role is never discussed. You might say what you have learned, what now fits and what needs a different agreement. That keeps the choice understandable to others. The count cannot show whether you are rebellious, resilient, insecure or likely to cope with difficult circumstances, and it creates no obligation to disclose private experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 角色变了却没说，伙伴也可能难以配合。可以说明新了解到什么、什么现在适合、什么需要另约，让别人理解这个选择。计数看不出叛逆、韧性、不安全感或面对困难的能力，也不产生透露个人经历的义务。

title.en: Try a role with a review point
title.zh: 给试角色留一个回看点

paragraphs.en: Choose one optional unfamiliar task, a small first version and a moment to decide whether you want to continue. Ask what help is available and communicate any change. Afterwards notice what the trial taught you about this task alone. You do not have to prove that you can adapt everywhere or let a character match dictate how much of yourself to reveal.
paragraphs.zh: 选一项自愿的陌生任务、一个小起步版本，再约个时点决定是否继续。问清支持，调整时说明。结束后只看这次尝试让自己了解了这项任务什么，不必证明到哪里都能适应，也不让人物匹配决定要透露多少自己。

title.en: A limited Yasu reading

paragraphs.en: Yasushi Takagi, called Yasu, is Black Stones’ drummer and is also connected with legal work in the story. Here the limited angle is clarifying responsibility, support and boundaries in a shared activity. Your selections do not measure wisdom, maturity, moral clarity, legal competence or a duty to protect others. The fictional role provides context, without authorising advice about a real dispute.
paragraphs.zh: 高木泰士被叫作Yasu，是Black Stones鼓手，作品里也与法律工作有关。本版有限角度是在共同活动中说清责任、支持与边界。本次选择不测智慧、成熟、道德清晰、法律能力，也不产生保护他人的义务。虚构角色只提供背景，不授权处理真实纠纷的建议。

title.en: Two expectations, one manageable agreement
title.zh: 两份期待，一份能承担的约定

paragraphs.en: Two people expect you to handle the same creative task in different ways. You bring the expectations into one conversation, state what you can do and invite an agreement everyone understands. That can prevent invisible responsibilities from accumulating. It does not require you to become the permanent mediator or take over decisions that belong to the people involved.
paragraphs.zh: 两个人希望自己用不同方式处理同一创作任务，可以把期待放进同一次讨论，说清能做什么，邀请大家约出都明白的方案。这能减少看不见的责任堆积，不要求永久当调解者，也不接管本来属于当事人的决定。

title.en: Coordination beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Nana Osaki names the expressive idea; Hachi notices everyday connection and Ren works on a concrete detail. Takumi aligns the aim with resources, Nobu speaks appreciatively and Shin tries an adjustable role. Yasu’s angle makes the responsibility between those contributions explicit. Clear agreements can serve creative freedom and warmth, without making one person the most mature or responsible member.
paragraphs.zh: 大崎娜娜说出表达想法，阿八注意日常联结，莲打磨具体细节；巧让目标和资源相配，伸夫表达欣赏，真一试可调整角色。泰士角度把贡献之间的责任说清。清楚约定可以服务创作自由和温暖相处，不评谁是最成熟、最有责任心的人。

title.en: Support includes your own boundary
title.zh: 支持也包括自己的边界

paragraphs.en: A useful agreement leaves space for your own time and wishes. If everyone relies on you to hold the arrangement together, ask which responsibility can be shared instead of silently accepting more. This is a possible project adjustment, not evidence that your result identifies self-sacrifice, hidden feelings or a role you must play in your friendships. The group remains responsible for its decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 有用的约定也给自己的时间和意愿留空间。大家都靠自己撑安排时，可以问哪项责任能共担，不默默再接更多。这是项目里可能的调整，不证明结果识别出自我牺牲、隐藏感情，或规定在友谊里必须扮演什么。小组仍对自己的决定负责。

title.en: Ask for one explicit agreement

paragraphs.en: For the next small shared activity, clarify who decides, who carries each practical part and when the arrangement can be reviewed. Include a straightforward way for someone to step back. Afterwards ask whether the agreement made participation easier. This is a trial of everyday coordination, not professional mediation, legal advice or proof that you should guide other people’s lives.
paragraphs.zh: 下次共同小活动，约清谁决定、谁承担哪部分实际工作、何时可以回看安排，也留一个容易退出的办法。之后问这份约定是否让参与更轻松。这是在试日常协调，不是专业调解、法律建议，也不证明该由自己引导别人的人生。
